music.title: Music
music.ready: Music is ready. Write your song below.
music.notLoadedWhy: Press Switch to Music. The computer stops what it is running now and loads music. It takes a few minutes.
music.notInstalled: Music is not installed on this computer.
music.notInstalledWhy: Songs are made by a music program that is not on this computer yet.
music.notInstalledFix: Connect the AI-ARK drive and use "Install what is missing" on the Status screen, or ask the lab owner to install music.
music.starting: Music is starting. This can take a few minutes. You can write your song meanwhile.
music.stopping: Music is stopping. Wait a moment, then switch to Music again.
music.failedFix: Press Switch to Music to start it again. If it fails twice, restart the computer.
music.survival: Music does not run in survival mode.
music.survivalFix: Survival mode keeps the emergency brain running. Leave survival mode first, then come back here.
music.signIn: Music needs the Local AI app of this computer.
music.signInFix: Open Local AI from this computer's menu, or sign in on the first page with a code from the lab owner.
music.statusFailed: The computer did not answer about music.
